newsitem.title: USA: GMS Group hires eight municipal bond sales people.
newsitem.headline: GMS Group hires eight municipal bond sales people.

text.p: New Jersey-based GMS Group has lured eight municipal institutional sales professionals to its staff, including six from rival JB Hanauer & Co, sources at GMS confirmed Wednesday.
The new hires come in the wake of Louis D'Andrea's departure from JB Hanauer to GMS in April. D'Andrea, a senior vice president in municipal institutional sales, heads the department at GMS.

Counting D'Andrea is one of the six. The five other JB Hanauer professionals who have left for GMS since April are Philip Dillon, Joel Shilling, E. Michael Shine, Gary Milotta and Todd Rogers, said D'Andrea.

In addition, Bill Schroeder, formerly of Reinoso & Co, and John Ceresa, formerly of Prudential Securities Inc, have joined the firm, he said. Before the new hires, GMS had three institutional salesmen, and the firm expects to hire three more by June, D'Andrea said.
D'Andrea said he is unsure whether GMS would continue to expand once the June hires are on board.
"But we are definitely taking a look at hiring very good qualified institutional salesmen with relationships and very good experience," he said.
Most of the recent hires are professionals who have been in the business more than 20 years, D'Andrea said.

"And John Feeney who runs the GMS Group has given us the ability to trade, underwrite and cross bonds institutionally, and has given us a very good situation over here," he said. "We are very happy to be here."
Feeney is GMS Group's president and chief executive officer.
In addition to heading the municipal institutional sales department, D'Andrea will engage in some institutional trading as well, he said.

"Several of us will be wearing trading hats also, Phil Dillon, myself and Mike Shine do trade also, but there's several traders here already," D'Andrea said, adding that GMS currently has seven other traders.
D'Andrea plans to focus on institutional business "up and down the curve," he said.

"You know we are doing a very good job in the serials, and we do a very good job in the long end of the market also," D'Andrea said. "GMS is noted for their high-yield and distressed situation trading, so we want to incorporate that also in our institutional coverage."
GMS Group is based in Livingston, N.J., while JB Hanauer is based in Parsippany.
